prior_importants.description: The `include` narrowed to `['test/**/*.test.ts']`, but three test files still live under `src/adapters/` at HEAD (capability-utils, failing-tests, vitest-config-utils). They existed unchanged at base and the PR does not touch them. vitest no longer collects them, so 27 test cases stop running and no error is raised.

findings.description: The pytest `failingTests` case and the `pythonAdapter` half of the "names nothing in output that holds no summary" case test `src/adapters/python.adapter.ts`, but they sit in the typescript-adapter test file, although `test/unit/adapters/python-adapter.test.ts` exists.

process_issues.description: No consolidator was spawned because only one finding came back, so there was nothing to deduplicate. Skipped on this test-only delta: security (no trust boundary), guards (no non-test source changed), simplicity (no new construct), docs (comments moved verbatim), context, maintainability, spec, workflow-safety.
